modelDescription: If you are looking for a quality, craftsmen built Weatherby Mark V and want new features for rugged durability and long-range accuracy look no further than the Mark V Accumark. The Accumark features a fluted #3 contour barrel, and hand-laid fiberglass stock with aluminum bedding blocks. Built on both 6-Lug, 9-Lug, and left-handed Mark V receivers, the Accumark is one of the most customizable models in the Weatherby line. Ready to put holes through dimes at distance and knock large animals down fast, the most versatile performance hunting rifle on the market.
